card.name: Linking words in MAOI washout timing
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, before starting, or) in MAOI washout rules, such as 'within 7 days of stopping treatment'. Also seen on a few other small words before a treatment verb or purpose phrase.

modes.label: MAOI washout wording
modes.description: Linking word right before 'stopping' or 'starting' in the rule about spacing an MAOI and an antidepressant.
modes.example: Do not use MAOIs intended to treat psychiatric disorders with desvenlafaxine or within 7 days<< of>> stopping treatment with desvenlafax

modes.label: Other small words before treatment verbs
modes.description: A small word before a verb like prevent or a noun like treatment in warnings and dosing text.
modes.example: Do not use estrogens with or without progestins to<< prevent>> heart disease, heart attacks, or strokes

card.plain: It lights up on the small connecting words in the rule about waiting days between stopping one drug and starting an MAOI.
